svg.title: LeWorldModel latent-space architecture block diagram
svg.desc: Block diagram of the LeWorldModel system. An RGB input of shape 3 by 224 by 224 feeds a ViT-tiny encoder (12 layers, hidden dimension 192), which outputs a 192-dimensional latent z_t. A history of three recent latents and three action embeddings feeds a 6-layer transformer predictor that outputs the next predicted latent. The predicted latents and a goal latent feed a cost head computing squared Euclidean distance in latent space, which a CEM-MPC planner (300 samples, 30 iterations, horizon 5) consumes to choose the next action to execute in the environment. A "Pixel Decoder" box near the top is drawn struck-out, indicating the architecture deliberately omits any module that decodes latents back to pixels. Total parameter count is 18.03 million.
